description: This PHP source file defines the 'Sale' model class for the OpenCart admin reporting extension. It provides methods to retrieve various sales-related data such as total sales, orders by geographic region, temporal distributions (by day, week, month, year), detailed order information, taxes, and shipping data. The methods interact with the database to perform aggregate queries, filter data based on provided criteria, and return structured results for reporting purposes.

classes.name: Sale
classes.description: Model class for generating sales reports in OpenCart admin panel, including methods for aggregating sales, order, tax, and shipping data.

methods.name: getTotalSales
methods.description: Returns the total sales amount with optional date filtering.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCountry
methods.description: Retrieves total number of orders and their amounts grouped by country.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByDay
methods.description: Provides order counts per hour for the current day, filtered by order statuses.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByWeek
methods.description: Provides daily order counts over the current week, filtered by order statuses.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByMonth
methods.description: Provides order counts for each day in the current month, filtered by order statuses.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByYear
methods.description: Provides monthly order counts for the current year, filtered by order statuses.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Returns detailed order summaries based on filters like status, date range, and grouping.

methods.name: getTotalOrders
methods.description: Counts total unique orders based on filters and grouping criteria.

methods.name: getTaxes
methods.description: Retrieves tax totals grouped by time period and including tax title.

methods.name: getTotalTaxes
methods.description: Counts total distinct tax records based on filters.

methods.name: getShipping
methods.description: Returns shipping-related totals grouped by time period and shipping title.

methods.name: getTotalShipping
methods.description: Counts total shipping records based on filters.
